search_window.basis: Most recent independently verified prior Food Line Source Watch heartbeat completed October 30, 2026 at 21:50:51.982 PDT; the recall watch ran on October 30 Pacific date. coverage_notes: Supplementary, bounded watch only; production nationwide collector remains authoritative. No review approval, publication, schedule change, or task disablement performed.

Twelve targeted web searches completed in two batches (four sole/last/full-service grocery closures, three weather/disaster emergency food distribution cancellations, two abrupt food pantry/bank closures, three SNAP/WIC/EBT interruptions). No search tool failures observed.

No new U.S. loss of sole/full-service grocery, disaster-caused distribution cancellation, abrupt pantry/bank closure, or official SNAP/WIC access interruption was independently verified within the interval.

Filtered search hits with explicit 2024, 2025, September or earlier October 2026 event dates; e.g. Spencer NY September grocery fire, Eastport ME earlier-only-grocer loss, October 7-9 Alabama weather cancellations, and 2025 SNAP shutdown reports.
Excluded October 30, 2026 Hockley TX Kroger store groundbreaking and September 2026 Aurora NC pantry opening because these expanded rather than reduced food access.
Filtered Canada (Baker Lake food bank fire May 2026), India (Odisha relief October 30 2026), non-food service matches, and unrelated state administrative documents.
The October 29 Kauaʻi hurricane recovery report did not substantiate a newly canceled October 30 food distribution. No cancellation inferred.
No result is not proof of absence in unindexed municipal bulletins or provider social feeds; this watch is intentionally bounded.
